bio.text: Mike Rogers is the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Michigan in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia.
Rogers represented Michigan's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House from 2001 to 2015, after serving in the Michigan Senate from 1995 to 2000.
Rogers was born in 1963 in Livingston County, Michigan, graduated from Adrian College in 1985 and served in the U.S. Army from 1985 to 1989.
Before entering politics Rogers worked as an FBI special agent; after leaving Congress the former congressman owned a business and worked as a cyber security professional.
